turns.content: In triangle ABC, BC=12 and angle B=30 degrees. Let AC=b and AC=c, and identify which side is opposite the given angle.
Derive an equation in c using the given 30° angle, and determine when two distinct real values of c exist.
Use the sum and product of the roots of the same quadratic in BC, and determine when both possible values of AB are positive.
Check whether either boundary value gives two distinct positive lengths.
List the admissible integer values of b.
Give the final number of integer values of AC that produce two positive values of AB.
